testsuite.name: run.trama.saga.redis.RedisConsumerResilienceTest

testcase.name: an item enqueued with a delay is claimed when due, without waiting for a full sweep()
a claimer survives Redis errors and resumes consuming()
the heartbeat fences a claim whose lease ran out()
a live claim erased by a Redis data loss is restored, not fenced()
a process never claims beyond its free capacity()
claims keep working after Redis forgets its scripts()
